name: schoolpro_subscription_finalize_rpc
statements: create or replace function public.finalize_schoolpro_subscription(p_intent uuid,p_transaction_ref text,p_amount numeric) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$ declare i public.schoolpro_subscription_intents%rowtype; c public.schoolpro_subscription_catalog%rowtype; r timestamptz; begin select * into i from public.schoolpro_subscription_intents where id=p_intent for update; if i.id is null or i.status<>'pending' or i.amount<>p_amount then raise exception 'Subscription payment mismatch'; end if; select * into c from public.schoolpro_subscription_catalog where id=i.catalog_id; r:=case i.billing_cycle when 'monthly' then now()+interval '1 month' when 'termly' then now()+interval '4 months' else now()+interval '1 year' end; insert into public.schoolpro_subscriptions(school_id,tier,billing_cycle,amount,status,starts_at,renews_at,managed_by_ihlink,updated_at) values(i.school_id,c.code,i.billing_cycle,i.amount,'active',now(),r,true,now()) on conflict(school_id) do update set tier=excluded.tier,billing_cycle=excluded.billing_cycle,amount=excluded.amount,status='active',starts_at=coalesce(public.schoolpro_subscriptions.starts_at,now()),renews_at=r,managed_by_ihlink=true,updated_at=now(); update public.schoolpro_subscription_intents set status='paid',transaction_ref=p_transaction_ref,paid_at=now(),updated_at=now() where id=i.id; return jsonb_build_object('status','active','school_id',i.school_id,'tier',c.code,'renews_at',r); end $$; revoke all on function public.finalize_schoolpro_subscription(uuid,text,numeric) from public,anon,authenticated; grant execute on function public.finalize_schoolpro_subscription(uuid,text,numeric) to service_role;

name: host_provisioning_authorized_roles
statements: create or replace function public.complete_host_provisioning(p_order uuid,p_provider_reference text,p_control_panel_url text default null,p_nameservers jsonb default '[]'::jsonb) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$ declare o public.host_orders%rowtype;s public.host_services%rowtype;stype text;sname text; begin if not public.host_can_provision() then raise exception 'Permission denied';end if;if nullif(btrim(p_provider_reference),'') is null then raise exception 'Confirmed provider reference is required';end if;select * into o from public.host_orders where id=p_order for update;if o.id is null or o.payment_status<>'paid' then raise exception 'Paid order required before provisioning';end if;if o.renewal_service_id is not null then update public.host_services set status='active',provider_reference=p_provider_reference,renews_at=coalesce(renews_at,current_date)+(o.billing_cycle_months||' months')::interval,updated_at=now() where id=o.renewal_service_id returning * into s;else stype:=case when o.order_type='domain_registration' then 'domain' else o.order_type end;sname:=case when stype='domain' then coalesce(o.domain_name,'Domain') else initcap(replace(stype,'_',' ')) end;insert into public.host_services(user_id,order_id,service_type,service_name,domain_name,status,provider_reference,control_panel_url,nameservers,activated_at,renews_at) values(o.user_id,o.id,stype,sname,o.domain_name,'active',p_provider_reference,p_control_panel_url,p_nameservers,now(),current_date+(o.billing_cycle_months||' months')::interval) returning * into s;end if;update public.host_orders set status='active',provisioning_status='completed',provider_reference=p_provider_reference,updated_at=now() where id=o.id;return jsonb_build_object('status','active','service_id',s.id);end $$;
